title_i18n.zh: 92% 工程师都在用 AI 后，Uber 开始给 AI “限额”了
title_i18n.en: With 92% of engineers using AI, Uber has started capping AI usage.

excerpt_i18n.zh: Uber 的“零增长技术栈”（Zero Growth Stack）提供了一种可扩展的基础设施解决方案，将容量增长与业务需求增长解耦，使公司能够在显著扩展服务规模的同时，减少物理硬件占用。通过优先推进自动化运行时优化以及严格的 AI 生命周期管理，这一战略转型降低了传统资源扩容带来的额外开销。该方法的核心在于系统性地转向动态系统控制，确保即使内部软件复杂度不断提升，基础设施性能依然能够保持高效。
excerpt_i18n.en: Uber's "Zero Growth Stack" provides a scalable infrastructure solution that decouples capacity growth from business demand growth, enabling the company to significantly expand service scale while reducing physical hardware footprint. By prioritizing automated runtime optimization and rigorous AI lifecycle management, this strategic shift reduces the overhead associated with traditional resource scaling. At its core, the approach involves a systematic transition toward dynamic system control, ensuring that infrastructure performance remains efficient even as internal software complexity continues to rise.
excerpt_i18n.es: El "Zero Growth Stack" (pila de crecimiento cero) de Uber ofrece una solución de infraestructura escalable que desacopla el crecimiento de la capacidad del crecimiento de la demanda empresarial, permitiendo a la empresa reducir la ocupación de hardware físico mientras expande significativamente la escala de sus servicios. Al priorizar la optimización automatizada del runtime y una estricta gestión del ciclo de vida de la IA, esta transformación estratégica reduce los gastos generales asociados con la expansión tradicional de recursos. El núcleo de este enfoque radica en un cambio sistemático hacia el control dinámico de sistemas, garantizando que el rendimiento de la infraestructura se mantenga eficiente incluso a medida que aumenta la complejidad del software interno.

excerpt_i18n.en: (Leiphone) Summary: "Outpacing in benchmark scores is just an appetizer; production-grade delivery is the real test." In June 2026, an open-source model named Boogu-Image-0.1 appeared on HuggingFace and quickly set the AI community abuzz. What made it stand out was that, with a mere 10B parameters, it surpassed models with far larger parameter counts across several key capabilities. Bigger means stronger—long a rock-solid belief in AI, true for language models and image models alike. But in the Qwen-Image-Bench benchmark, the 10B Boogu-Image-0.1 scored 53.58, ahead of the 20B Qwen-Image-2512 (52.06) and the 80B Hunyuan-Image-3.0 (50.81). Outperforming rivals at 1/8 or even 1/2 their parameter scale, even by just a few points, is enough to explain the industry's attention. Of course, benchmark scores are only one aspect of evaluating a model. More than benchmark scores, we care about how far this dark horse—small in size but mighty in performance—can go in real content production workflows. Does its advantage only hold up in benchmarks? Can it rapidly generate photorealistic assets and build poster layouts?

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 29, XtalPi officially released the XtalPi Science intelligent platform and the Genius Agents scientific agent matrix, and jointly established the "Science Intelligence Open Ecosystem Alliance" with 26 industrial, academic, and research ecosystem partners. Leveraging XtalPi Science, the alliance will provide members with diversified collaboration models such as access to platform and automated experimentation resources, model and tool integration, joint development, and private deployment, collectively driving efficient synergy among models, data, tools, and experimental capabilities. XtalPi Science is the world's first comprehensive AI for Science (AI4S) platform that integrates large language models (LLMs), scientific agents, and large-scale automated robotic experimentation. It encapsulates XtalPi's decade-long accumulation of models, tools, agents, and experimental resources into on-demand Science Tokens, elevating the system from an internal infrastructure serving individual projects to a global AI4S underlying infrastructure (Global Scientific Utility) that research organizations worldwide can access on demand. As the core scheduling hub and R&D matrix of the entire system, Genius Agents establishes a multi-agent system with both global planning and scenario-specific execution capabilities. It can autonomously understand complex scientific objectives, complete interdisciplinary long-horizon tasks, and significantly reduce model hallucination.

La alianza se apoyará en XtalPi Science para ofrecer a sus miembros diversos modos de cooperación, como el acceso a recursos de plataforma y automatización experimental, la integración de modelos y herramientas, el desarrollo conjunto y el despliegue privado, promoviendo así una colaboración eficiente entre modelos, datos, herramientas y capacidades experimentales. XtalPi Science es la primera a nivel mundial.
